problem_type: No/low water supply, water quality complaint, pipeline leakage, sewerage overflow/chokage, damaged manhole cover, billing dispute, need water tanker
municipality: Hyderabad Metropolitan Water Supply & Sewerage Board (HMWSSB) — a separate statutory board, NOT part of GHMC
department: Hyderabad Metropolitan Water Supply & Sewerage Board (HMWSSB), Operations & Maintenance Wing
authority: O&M Division Officer (one of 25 divisions covering specific GHMC wards — see Charter Annexures 2/3 for named officers/phone numbers)
description: HMWSSB's Citizens Charter (dated May 2024, the most recently updated source in this batch) publishes a detailed SLA table for water-supply and sewerage grievances: no water supply 4 days; low pressure 4 days; polluted water 4 days; water leakage 2 days; erratic supply timings 2 days; illegal motor use 4 days; sewerage overflow on road 2 days; sewerage chokage 2 days; manhole cover replacement 2 days; silt on road 2 days; excess-bill verification 7 days; e-issue of water bill 1 day; disconnection 7 days; dial-a-tanker 1 day. HMWSSB is organizationally separate from GHMC — it is a distinct statutory board responsible for water supply and sewerage across Hyderabad, while GHMC handles waste, roads, streetlights, and storm-water drainage. Service is delivered through 25 O&M Divisions, each covering specific GHMC wards with named officers and direct phone numbers (Charter Annexures 2 and 3).
procedure: Lodge a grievance via the 24x7 Call Centre, HMWSSB's website/app, or directly with the O&M Division Officer responsible for the citizen's ward (contact list in Charter Annexures 2/3).
sla: No water supply: 4 days. Low pressure: 4 days. Polluted water: 4 days. Water leakage: 2 days. Erratic supply timings: 2 days. Illegal motor use: 4 days. Sewerage overflow on road: 2 days. expected_resolution_time: Varies by issue type, 1-7 days — see sla field for the full per-service breakdown.
contact_information: Call Centre: 155313 (24x7). Email: mdhmwssb@hyderabadwater.gov.in. 25 O&M Divisions each with a named officer and direct phone number covering specific GHMC wards — see Charter Annexures 2/3.
escalation_procedure: Beyond the ward-level O&M Division Officer, citizens can raise issues directly with HMWSSB's Managing Director via the 'Meet/Dial your MD' programme held every 3rd Saturday, or via the weekly 'Prajavani' grievance programme held every Monday.
escalation_authority: Managing Director, HMWSSB (via 'Meet/Dial your MD', 3rd Saturday of each month)

faq.question: Who handles water supply and sewerage complaints in Hyderabad — GHMC or a separate body?
faq.answer: HMWSSB (Hyderabad Metropolitan Water Supply & Sewerage Board), a separate statutory board — not GHMC, which handles waste, roads, streetlights, and storm-water drainage instead.

faq.question: How quickly should a sewerage overflow on the road be fixed?
faq.answer: 2 days, per HMWSSB's May 2024 Citizens Charter SLA table.

faq.question: How do I request a water tanker?
faq.answer: Via the dial-a-tanker service, with a 1-day SLA.

citizen_guidance: For Hyderabad water-supply or sewerage issues, contact HMWSSB (not GHMC) via the 24x7 Call Centre (155313), the website/app, or your ward's O&M Division Officer. Resolution SLAs range from 1 day (dial-a-tanker, bill e-issue) to 7 days (billing verification, disconnection).
